shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

context.description_en: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 军团指挥官强制与目标敌方英雄进行决斗，持续短暂的数秒。决斗开始后双方英雄不能使用任何物品，而目标敌方英雄不能使用技能。如果有英雄在决斗期间死亡，赢得决斗的英雄将永久获得攻击力加成。
notes_en: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
notes_zh: 如果双方距离超过2000，决斗也会结束。

scepter_loc.zh: 如果军团指挥官在决斗中获胜，会在她周围自动触发强攻。

context.description_en: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
context.description_zh: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害回复一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
notes_en: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
notes_zh: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。

notes_en: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

shard_loc.zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

context.description_en: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
context.description_zh: 撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为%punch_attack_range%，并拥有移动速度加成。每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
notes_en: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
notes_zh: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后%grace_period%秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

definition_note: U31：骨灰类是用户指出的例外。目标字段只证明指向方式；格挡和反弹不能相互推断，也不能从大部分推为全部。物品例子的目标方式来自现有社区快照；v1抽取器仍绑定旧词表，不在此自动重跑。；U33：可主动施放或开关的攻击类技能（连击、天界箭袋、影武长刀）也算，但用户报告它们不触发法术反制、清莲宝珠、林肯法球；U51：CUSTOM阵营看能否选敌方单位（残岩魔咒、血盆大口的敌方小兵、投掷到敌方都算）

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
notes_en: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。

shard_loc.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
shard_loc.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

context.description_zh: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向%AbilityCastRange%范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。

context.description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
context.description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
notes_en: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。

context.description_en: Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
notes_en: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
notes_zh: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的%ricochet_distance_multiplier%倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。

scepter_loc.en: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
scepter_loc.zh: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。

context.description_en: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续%duration%秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

context.description_zh: 打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对减益免疫单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加破坏效果。

context.description_en: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
context.description_zh: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
notes_en: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.
notes_zh: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。

context.description_zh: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂眩晕，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
notes_en: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
notes_zh: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。

shard_loc.en: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
shard_loc.zh: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。

context.description_zh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。

context.description_en: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
context.description_zh: 殁境神蚀者的攻击附带基于剩余魔法值的额外纯粹伤害。
notes_en: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.
notes_zh: 根据使用此技能后的魔法值计算附加伤害。

context.description_en: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
context.description_zh: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
notes_en: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
notes_zh: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。

shard_loc.en: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
shard_loc.zh: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。

context.description_zh: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标眩晕。
notes_en: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

scepter_loc.en: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。

subject_zh: 食人魔魔法师·未精通的火焰爆轰
definition: 主动技能或物品施放时，可以选择敌方单位为目标；允许同一技能或物品也能选择友方。指向方式不推断是否触发林肯格挡或莲花反弹，具体交互分别核对。
definition_note: U31：骨灰类是用户指出的例外。目标字段只证明指向方式；格挡和反弹不能相互推断，也不能从大部分推为全部。物品例子的目标方式来自现有社区快照；v1抽取器仍绑定旧词表，不在此自动重跑。；U33：可主动施放或开关的攻击类技能（连击、天界箭袋、影武长刀）也算，但用户报告它们不触发法术反制、清莲宝珠、林肯法球；U51：CUSTOM阵营看能否选敌方单位（残岩魔咒、血盆大口的敌方小兵、投掷到敌方都算）

context.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
context.description_zh: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成%base_damage% + %str_multiplier%倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的%scepter_mana%%%。
notes_en: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

context.description_en:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
持续施法 - 将神谕者的力量汇聚为一股蕴含荡涤之力的能量，对敌方目标释放这股能量可以对其造成伤害，使其被缠绕，并且驱散其附近区域的魔法效果。如果目标是友军，将只造成驱散效果。缠绕时间随着持续施法时间逐渐提升。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Affects invulnerable units.
notes_zh: 可以作用无敌单位。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续%channel_time%秒。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒%pull_units_per_second%的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引%pull_distance_limit%距离。
notes_en: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
notes_zh: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。

definition: 主动技能或物品施放时，可以选择敌方单位为目标；允许同一技能或物品也能选择友方。指向方式不推断是否触发林肯格挡或莲花反弹，具体交互分别核对。

context.description_en:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
context.description_zh:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard_loc.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。
